# Documents every reader of teq.lock refuses, each after a line `=== <line> <why>` naming the line
# its refusal names: tests/lock.sh holds lock.js and check-export.py to it, teq's unit test lock.rs.
=== 4 a float where a string or an integer stands
teq: 0.1.2
format: 1
binaries: {}
a: 1.0
